final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / (HCT / 100.0)) AS patient_average FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(patient_average) AS value FROM patient_averages), first_kept AS (SELECT p.patient_average, p.patient_average - f.value AS first_difference FROM patient_averages AS p JOIN first_average AS f ON f.value IS NOT NULL WHERE p.patient_average > f.value), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(patient_average) AS value FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT k.patient_average, k.first_difference, k.patient_average - s.value AS second_difference FROM first_kept AS k JOIN second_average AS s ON s.value IS NOT NULL WHERE k.patient_average > s.value) SELECT AVG(patient_average), AVG(first_difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM final_kept
